overview.name: Hexis Active Nicotine Engagement ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in companies that have at least 50% of their revenue attributable to the global tobacco and nicotine sectors (“Tobacco/Nicotine Companies”). It is non-diversified.
